projects.name: Rubrik DR backup
notes: Roadmap deck (I&O Project Roadmap.pptx, modified 2026-10-16): PM Igor Kulyk, TL Calvin Cochran, Jira IOSP-471. Status badge High-Risk on the portfolio slide and Off Track on the project slide; Schedule R, Scope G, Cost G.

Accomplishments: team coordinating Rubrik deployment and MCR cluster readiness; last brik/node for the MCR cluster being brought online; NetOps to check NIC in the data center; 1gig cross connect network resolved; storage issue (tracked in Teams subchannel) resolved; POC parallel run 10/2 (initial finished in 16 hours, incremental 3 hours); Pure-based backup successful.

Next: configure CA Backup VLAN on RAC (RM-1658, Oct 17); enable RAC instance backup (target Oct 18); appliance shipment to Manchester (Oct 27 - Nov 9); rack and stack in Manchester (Nov 9 - 16); production preparation (Nov 16 - Dec 6).

Milestones: next milestone Oct 16 (enable Rubrik RAC backup), which is past due versus the RAC backup target of Oct 18; production implementation Dec 6 (full production in Europe); project completion December 2026.
Roadmap appendix timeline shows Rubrik as Executing.
An earlier draft of the deck (Project Roadmap DRAFT CorpTemplate.pptx, 2026-10-08) had next milestone Oct 6-27 (Pure and RAC backup validation); the 2026-10-16 deck supersedes it.
projects.progress: Pure-based backup successful; RAC backup enablement in progress (target Oct 18); Manchester appliance shipment from Oct 27
projects.timeline: Next milestone Oct 16 (enable RAC backup); Manchester shipment Oct 27 - Nov 9; rack and stack Nov 9-16; production prep Nov 16 - Dec 6; full production Dec 6; completion Dec 2026
risks: RAC backup milestone (Oct 16) slipped to target Oct 18
